about: Deliberately broken builds of the lending AMM, each one careless edit to a copy of its source, built by scripts/broken-builds.py and run by tests/broken_builds.rs, which checks that the invariant fuzzer (tests/common/fuzz.rs) catches each one by the invariant named. The program's own source never carries them.

builds.name: removal-rounds-up
builds.why: A removal's parts rounded up instead of down, so an LP takes more than their shares' part.
builds.invariant: [only a fall in Kamino's rate lowers R x L or an LP share's value]
builds.find: let part = |whole: u64| (whole as u128 * lp as u128 / n) as u64;
builds.replace: let part = |whole: u64| (whole as u128 * lp as u128).div_ceil(n) as u64;

builds.name: swap-output-rounds-up
builds.why: A swap's output rounded up instead of down, in the trader's favour.
builds.invariant: [only a fall in Kamino's rate lowers R x L or an LP share's value]
builds.find: let out = (reserve_out as u128 * net / denominator) as u64;
builds.replace: let out = (reserve_out as u128 * net).div_ceil(denominator) as u64;

builds.name: swap-pays-less-than-its-quote
builds.why: The swap pays out one unit less than the quote it priced.

builds.name: adding-records-more-than-it-takes
builds.why: Adding liquidity records one unit more of each side than it took in.

builds.name: swap-loses-a-unit-from-its-books
builds.why: A swap records one unit less of its input than it took in, so a unit leaves the books while staying in the vault.

builds.name: no-sale-beyond-the-buffer
builds.why: The missing check of what Kamino can pay: every sale paying out more than the buffer is refused, though Kamino could pay its shortfall.

builds.name: no-removal-in-kind-in-withdraw-mode
builds.why: A removal in kind refused while the market is in withdraw mode, which Kamino's thin liquidity brings on.
builds.invariant: [a removal in kind succeeds in every Kamino state]

builds.name: swap-redeems-an-extra-ctoken
builds.why: A swap's redeem burns one cToken more than its shortfall needs.
builds.invariant: [a swap never deposits and redeems only its shortfall]

builds.name: deposits-while-blocked
builds.why: The missing check of `block_ctoken_usage`: rebalance plans a deposit while Kamino blocks cToken deposits.
builds.invariant: [rebalance moves only towards its target, only redeems in withdraw mode and never deposits while blocked]

builds.name: leaves-withdraw-mode-early
builds.why: Withdraw mode left as soon as the free liquidity is back at the entry threshold, not above the exit threshold.
builds.invariant: [withdraw mode holds while Kamino's free liquidity is thin]
builds.find: } else if free > WITHDRAW_MODE_EXIT as u128 * exposure {
builds.replace: } else if free >= WITHDRAW_MODE_ENTER as u128 * exposure {

builds.name: removal-burns-a-share-short
builds.why: A removal burns one LP share less than it pays for.
builds.invariant: [the share count and the lock account move only as they may]

builds.name: adds-to-a-deprecated-reserve
builds.why: The missing check of a deprecated reserve: adding liquidity is allowed after a total write-off, though no redeem will ever come from it.
builds.invariant: [each call does what Kamino's state allows]
